|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk (V)]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk (V) (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 27 release sheet<ref name="sheet27-20261013">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-27.pdf Virtual Set 27 release sheet] (PDF, 6 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2026”; file created 13 October 2026). Released with [[Virtual Set 27]] (9 October 2026); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 3, file created 13 October 2026: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Once per turn, may deploy Wuta from Reserve Deck; reshuffle (or Chewbacca's Bowcaster; or lose 1 Force to deploy it from Lost Pile) here. Characters may not be excluded from battles here. If Bunker has been 'blown away,' opponent's Force retrieval is canceled.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk (V)]] (Original). The sheet prints a partial slip under the label “•Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk (V)”: the lower part of the PC card image of [[Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk (V)]] (published 19 August 2026) — the bars and game-text box down to the lower-left name — pixel for pixel the same, to be laid over the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Chewbacca Of Kashyyyk]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
